verdict.rationale: Real-time GPU availability by type and region is a fair question for a GPU cloud, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only instance types, a provisioning REST API, and "first-come access." Nothing shows Lambda itself exposing live capacity or stock by GPU type and region before launch. The community CLI/MCP server that can "find" instances is a third-party tool and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see real-time GPU availability by type and region before I try to provision, instead of discovering stockouts by failure
